```{r}
# --- Setup
# Load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)
library(here)

# Settings
cols_dp <- c("chr", "start", "end", "locus", "nvar", "sample")
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 14))
theme_update(
  plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
)

# Define the input files
var_file_dir <- here("results/geno/consensus")
var_files <- list.files(var_file_dir, full.names = TRUE, pattern = ".*-per-region.txt")
meta_file <- here("data/meta/anchor_all_locations.csv")
locus_meta_file <- here("results/blast_probes/probe_lengths.txt")
```

```{r}
# --- Read and process the input files

# Sample metadata
meta <- read_csv(meta_file, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  select(sample = code, species, locality, state, type) |>
  mutate(species = sub("_", ". ", species))

# Locus metadata
locus_meta <- read_tsv(locus_meta_file, col_names = c("locus", "length"), col_types = "ci") |>
  mutate(locus = sub("Bothrops_I9999_", "", locus))

# Files with variant counts per locus
var <- read_tsv(
  var_files,
  col_names = cols_dp,
  col_types = "ciicic",
  col_select = c(4, 6, 5),
  ) |>
  mutate(
    sample = sub("P0021_FG_", "", sample),
    locus = sub("Bothrops_I9999_", "", locus)
  ) |>
  left_join(meta, by = "sample") |>
  left_join(locus_meta, by = "locus")
```

```{r}
# Means by sample
var_smp <- var |>
  mutate(nvar_100bp = (nvar / length) * 100) |>
  summarize(nvar_100bp = mean(nvar_100bp), .by = sample) |>
  left_join(meta, by = "sample") |>
  drop_na()

# Means by locus (for jararaca only)
var_loc <- var |>
  filter(species == "B. jararaca") |> 
  summarize(nvar = mean(nvar), .by = "locus") |>
  left_join(locus_meta, by = "locus") |>
  mutate(nvar_100bp = (nvar / length) * 100)
```

## By-sample plots

```{r}
var_smp |>
  ggplot(aes(x = species, fill = species, y = nvar_100bp)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, fill = "grey40", shape = 21, alpha = 0.5, size = 2.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 50, by = 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of SNPs per 100 bp") +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(face = "italic"))

# SUSPICIOUS INSULARIS SAMPLE:
var_smp |> filter(species == "B. insularis", nvar_100bp > 2) # I1684
```

```{r}
# jararaca mainland vs island
var_smp |>
  filter(species == "B. jararaca") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = type, fill = type, y = nvar_100bp)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, fill = "grey40", shape = 21, alpha = 0.5, size = 2.5) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of SNPs per 100 bp") +
  guides(fill = "none")

# jararaca by state
var_smp |>
  filter(species == "B. jararaca") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = state, fill = state, y = nvar_100bp)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, fill = "grey40", shape = 21, alpha = 0.5, size = 2.5) +
  labs(x = "State", y = "Number of SNPs per 100 bp") +
  guides(fill = "none")
```

## By-locus plots

```{r}
var_loc |>
  ggplot(aes(x = nvar_100bp)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "steelblue", color = "grey40") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.03))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.03))) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of SNPs per 100 bp",
    y = "Number of loci",
    title = "B. jararaca only", 
  )

var_loc |>
  mutate(length_cat = ifelse(length < 250, "short", "long")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = length_cat, y = nvar_100bp)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, fill = "grey40", shape = 21, alpha = 0.25, size = 2.5) +
  labs(title = "B. jararaca only", y = "Number of SNPs per 100 bp")
```

## Individual-sample plots

```{r}
var |>
  filter(sample %in% unique(var$sample)[1:25]) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = nvar, y = sample)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(y = NULL, x = "Number of SNPs")
```

```{r}
var |>
  filter(sample %in% unique(var$sample)[1:25]) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = nvar, y = sample)) +
  geom_density_ridges() +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 20), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(y = NULL, x = "Number of SNPs") +
  theme_ridges()
```
